clips.title: The story
paras: Bingles' Screwdriver lies among the gear scattered across Loch Modan's northern islands. Gnome pilot Bingles Blastenheimer lost it when troggs plundered his crashed gyrocopter.

Bingles Blastenheimer lost the tools he needs to repair his gyrocopter when he crashed into Loch Modan. Troggs on the nearby islands carried off his tool buckets, and the screwdriver was packed in one of them. Bingles needs the screwdriver to make fine adjustments as he repairs the craft and handles its armaments.

Bingles works to free Gnomeregan from troggs and leper gnomes. He plans to combine his flying skill with volatile Blastencapper munitions for an aerial assault. Recovering the screwdriver, wrench, and hammer will help him rebuild his gyrocopter and keep the airborne counteroffensive alive.
